title: Digital-arrest call (English), recorded
description: An AI scammer (a Gemini script-writer reacting to the decoy's actual words, voiced by Gemini text-to-speech, all fictional) phones the live decoy. Everything on the right, from the transcript to the confirmed UPI ID and bank account, was produced by the real pipeline during this call. Both voices are exactly what each side produced; the pauses between turns are shortened, and the measured reply delay is in the stats.

steps: Falsely identify as a law enforcement officer investigating a seized contraband parcel linked to the victim's identity.
Threaten immediate arrest and demand absolute secrecy to prevent the victim from seeking outside help.
Instruct the victim to transfer money to a verification account under the guise of a refundable deposit.
Impose an urgent deadline and demand staying on the call until the transfer is verified.
redFlags: Threatens you with immediate arrest over the phone unless you pay money.
Forbids you from speaking to family members or telling anyone else.
Demands urgent money transfers to personal UPI IDs or private company accounts.
strain.paymentMethod: UPI transfer or bank account transfer
scriptExcerpts: Sir, your Aadhaar was used to send banned drugs and five fake passports, so [CASE_NUMBER] is registered against you.
To prove your innocence immediately, transfer a refundable deposit of ₹50,000 to verification ID [UPI_ID].
You have only 30 minutes to complete the transfer before the team reaches your house, so stay on the line and send the payment screenshot immediately.
